diagnosis: The first recolor changed hue but retained the large dark field and heavy monochrome silhouettes. The revision addresses value, color-area balance and the life of the scene, using real garden / lakeside photographs and official descriptions as context rather than assigning one color to Jiangsu.
designScope: The Nanjing-Yangzhou-Suzhou route in this booklet; no claim to a universal Jiangsu visual identity.

decisions.mainSurfaces: warm near-white with pale natural washes
decisions.cover: pale water, white plaster / grey roofs, varied sunlit greens and restrained warm accents
decisions.nightScene: real Qinhuai night photograph retained locally; the rest of the Nanjing page returns to a light reading surface
